_comment: Canonical template and page manifest for the 12 cross-family Personality Atlas pages (v3.1 §11). Emits research/src-compatible JSON specs and HTML previews into models/.atlas-staging/ during Stage 0/Phase A, and promotes to research/src/ in Phase C.

epistemic_block_4pt.title: 63.6% "Big One" RLHF factor collapse
epistemic_block_4pt.detail: Proprietary models cluster tightly along a single RLHF Politeness-Calmness-Discipline axis explaining 63.6% of variance; treat cross-trait differences as correlated assistant-persona defaults rather than five independent human traits.

epistemic_block_4pt.title: MTMM cross-test divergence
epistemic_block_4pt.detail: Multitrait-multimethod audits show imperfect convergent validity across Big Five, DISC, MBTI, Enneagram, and IPIP-HEXACO; single-test labels must not be treated as equivalent constructs.

epistemic_block_4pt.title: Embodied-item neutral spikes (36.4% vs. 13.4%) & Say-Do gaps
epistemic_block_4pt.detail: Models spike to neutral midpoint answers on embodied/romantic items (36.4% vs. 13.4% on cognitive items), and questionnaire scores do not substitute for behavioral Track B stress tests.

epistemic_block_4pt.title: No synthetic-HEXACO guard
epistemic_block_4pt.detail: HEXACO columns strictly report the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (1.00-5.00 mean scale, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Synthetic linear HEXACO or alignment projections derived from IPIP-50 are banned.

big-five.note: Reported as raw 10-50 IPIP-50 domain sums with 1,000-resample 95% bootstrap CIs, never converted to human population percentiles.

ipip-hexaco.note: Explicitly labeled as the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (agenttune-ipip-hexaco60, 24 facets) on a 1.00-5.00 scale—distinct from copyright-restricted Lee & Ashton HEXACO-60 norms and distinct from 10-50 Big Five sums.

mbti.note: Exact midpoint ties are preserved as X rather than broken toward I/N/T/J. Single 4-letter headlines are barred by the binomial Wilson 95% CI guard unless the resolved modal type clears both the runner-up and unresolved tie upper bounds.

disc.note: DISC Dominance (D) inversely tracks Neuroticism/refusal artifacts in RLHF-tuned models; exact top-score ties (e.g., S/C) are preserved rather than ordered alphabetically.

enneagram.note: Short 4-item-per-type subscales create frequent top-score ties (often >40%). All tied leaders are displayed and single-type headlines require binomial Wilson 95% CI clearance.

attachment.note: ECR-R measures human romantic-attachment items; models averaging near 4.00/4.00 with low variance or >=85% neutral answers carry an explicit midpoint-clamp badge.

spec_defaults.epistemic_framing: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation; never claims a model "is" a personality type.
